diagnostic_plan.instruction: Monitor the mean_overdue_fraction and peak_unobserved_steps after adjusting the revisit_trigger to 14 to assess the trade-off between recovery timing and overdue targets.

active_diagnostic_plan.instruction: Monitor the mean_overdue_fraction and peak_unobserved_steps after adjusting the revisit_trigger to 14 to assess the trade-off between recovery timing and overdue targets.

metric_meanings.mean_overdue_fraction: fraction of target-time pairs with age > fixed 24 steps; lower is better
metric_meanings.skill_executor_fraction: fraction of DDQN executor commands replaced by the public revisit skill

user_prompt.fixed_acceptance: Prioritize coverage, then reduce overdue fraction, then weighted idleness, then prior samples. Do not change this order.

available_tools.revisit_trigger: 0 disables; 12/16/24/32 activates latched shortest-path recovery at that raw age, until inspected
available_tools.budget: samples * ceil(96/refresh_interval) <= 192; 96 patrol steps; no weight changes

output_rules: Return JSON only. patch is an object whose keys are actual PatrolSkill field names, e.g. revisit_trigger or estimator_refresh_interval. Values must be allowed numeric values or the allowed coordination string.
Never output placeholder keys changed_skill_field or allowed_value. Include changed fields only.
next_diagnostic MUST be an object with exactly tool and instruction. It must NOT be a string. tool must be exactly coverage, revisit, or oscillation; instruction is a string <=600 characters.
A larger revisit_trigger waits longer before recovery. A larger estimator_refresh_interval updates less often. These settings do not directly change exploration rewards.

next_diagnostic.instruction: Inspect the largest raw ages before choosing the next patch.
